description: This file declares the WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory class, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerTaskFactory interface. It provides factory methods to create various WebAudioPlayer tasks such as play, pause, stop, setCaps, eos, setVolume, writeBuffer, and handleBusMessage, for the WebAudioPlayer component in the Rialto media server.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating WebAudioPlayer tasks such as play, pause, stop, setCaps, eos, setVolume, writeBuffer, and handleBusMessage, used within the Rialto media server.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with a client, gstWrapper, and glibWrapper dependencies.

methods.name: createShutdown
methods.description: Creates a task to shut down the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createStop
methods.description: Creates a task to stop the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createPlay
methods.description: Creates a task to start playback on the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createPause
methods.description: Creates a task to pause playback on the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createSetCaps
methods.description: Creates a task to set the media capabilities (caps) for the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createEos
methods.description: Creates a task to signal end-of-stream for the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createSetVolume
methods.description: Creates a task to set the volume of the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createWriteBuffer
methods.description: Creates a task to write audio buffers to the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createHandleBusMessage
methods.description: Creates a task to handle bus messages from GStreamer related to the WebAudioPlayer.
